(2022) , solves optimum allocation problem one-sided upper-bound constraints. assumes unit costs constant equal 1, .e., \(c_h = 1,\, h = 1,\ldots,H\).

title: Recursive Neyman Algorithm for Optimum Sample Allocation under Box Constraints (RNABOX) — rnabox
text: Implements Recursive Neyman Algorithm Optimum Sample Allocation Box Constraints (RNABOX), proposed Wesołowski et al. (2024) . algorithm solves following optimum allocation problem, formulated mathematical optimization terms: Minimize $$f(x_1,\ldots,x_H) = \sum_{h=1}^H \frac{^2_h}{x_h}$$ \(\mathbb R_+^H\), subject $$\sum_{h=1}^H x_h = n,$$ $$m_h \leq x_h \leq M_h, \qquad h = 1,\ldots,H,$$ \(n > 0,\, A_h > 0,\, m_h > 0,\, M_h > 0\), \(m_h < M_h,\, h = 1,\ldots,H\), \(\sum_{h=1}^H m_h \leq n \leq \sum_{h=1}^H M_h\), given numbers. Inequality constraints optional may omitted.
